1.name: Gastrointestinal issue
1.description: Symptoms indicate a possible gastrointestinal disturbance involving the stomach or digestion.
1.action: Maintain hydration and light meals. Consult a healthcare professional if symptoms persist or worsen.

2.name: Migraine or headache disorder
2.description: Symptoms are consistent with a migraine or related headache disorder.
2.action: Rest in a quiet, dark environment and stay hydrated. Seek medical advice if headaches are severe or frequent.

3.name: General viral illness
3.description: Symptoms are consistent with a possible viral illness.
3.action: Rest, maintain hydration, and monitor symptoms. Seek medical care if fever or weakness persists.

4.name: Musculoskeletal pain
4.description: Symptoms suggest pain involving muscles, joints, or bones.
4.action: Rest the affected area and avoid strain. Seek medical advice if pain is severe or ongoing.

5.name: Upper respiratory infection
5.description: Symptoms indicate a possible upper respiratory tract infection.
5.action: Rest, stay hydrated, and monitor symptoms. Seek medical care if breathing difficulty or high fever develops.

6.name: Fever-related illness
6.description: Symptoms suggest a fever-related condition or infection.
6.action: Monitor temperature and maintain hydration. Consult a healthcare professional if fever persists.

7.name: Digestive discomfort
7.description: Symptoms suggest mild digestive discomfort such as bloating or indigestion.
7.action: Eat light meals and stay hydrated. Seek medical advice if symptoms persist or worsen.

8.name: Tension headache
8.description: Symptoms are consistent with a tension-type headache.
8.action: Rest, manage stress, and stay hydrated. Seek medical advice if headaches become frequent or severe.

9.name: Allergic reaction
9.description: Symptoms may indicate an allergic response.
9.action: Avoid known triggers and monitor symptoms. Seek urgent care if swelling or breathing difficulty occurs.

10.name: Dehydration symptoms
10.description: Symptoms suggest possible dehydration or fluid imbalance.
10.action: Increase fluid intake and rest. Seek medical care if signs of severe dehydration appear.

11.name: Non-specific headache

11.action: Rest, hydrate, and monitor symptoms. Seek medical advice if headaches persist or worsen.

12.name: Ear or sinus issue
12.description: Symptoms suggest possible ear discomfort or sinus-related congestion.
12.action: Use supportive care and monitor symptoms. Consult a healthcare professional if symptoms persist.

13.action: Ensure adequate rest, nutrition, and hydration. Seek medical evaluation if fatigue continues.

14.name: Throat irritation

14.action: Stay hydrated and rest the voice. Seek medical advice if symptoms persist or worsen.

15.name: Neurological concern
15.description: Symptoms may indicate a neurological issue requiring careful monitoring.
15.action: Seek prompt medical evaluation, especially if symptoms include fainting, confusion, or vision changes.

16.name: General dizziness
16.action: Rest safely and hydrate. Seek medical care if dizziness is severe or recurrent.

17.name: Abdominal pain

17.action: Monitor symptoms and maintain hydration. Seek medical attention if pain is severe or persistent.

18.name: Nausea or vomiting

18.action: Stay hydrated and rest. Seek medical care if vomiting is persistent or severe.

19.name: Gastrointestinal upset
